name: Lake Tekapo
description: Lake Tekapo / Takapō and its township in the Mackenzie Basin, rebuilt 1:1 from LINZ's 1 m LiDAR and aerial imagery: the Church of the Good Shepherd, Mt John and its observatory, Lakes Alexandrina and McGregor, the Godley delta at the lake's head and the Two Thumb Range, under the Aoraki Mackenzie International Dark Sky Reserve.
frame_note: Local transverse Mercator on the township (pipeline/cityctx.py). In NZTM2000 (EPSG:2193) the frame's corners are E 1388072 N 5113286 (south-west), E 1424058 N 5114389 (south-east), E 1422471 N 5166364 (north-east) and E 1386485 N 5165269 (north-west): it meets the Lake Pukaki frame (east edge E 1390000) in a strip 2-3.5 km wide over the Tekapo canal and the Mary Range.

lake.name: Lake Tekapo / Takapō
lake.surface_note: the water surface in LINZ's hydro-flattened 1 m DEM (sheet BY17, from the 2015 Mackenzie capture); Wikipedia gives 710 m, and Genesis Energy runs the lake between about 701 and 710 m
lake.bathymetry_note: no open survey of the lake bed was found; the depth below the flattened surface is synthesised from the distance to the shore and the slope of the terrain around it (see docs/cities/lake-tekapo.md)

terrain.attribution: Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand (LINZ), New Zealand LiDAR 1 m DEM, CC BY 4.0
terrain.note: The national 1 m composite covers every sheet here (BX from the West Coast 2020-2022 capture, BY and BZ from Mackenzie 2015 and Canterbury 2016-2019); the Mackenzie 2026 capture (19 April - 2 May 2026) reaches north to latitude -43.739 and is the newer source south of that line.

imagery.attribution: Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand (LINZ): New Zealand 10 m Satellite Imagery (2025-2026), Mackenzie 0.3 m Rural Aerial Photos (2021), Mackenzie 0.075 m Urban Aerial Photos (2023, 2025-2026), CC BY 4.0

landmarks.note: heading is the altar end's bearing from true north: the long axis of the OpenStreetMap footprint (10.1 x 6.3 m) runs at 16.5 degrees, and the altar window looks north up the lake

the way the dog faces is nominal (north-north-east, over the lake); the position is the dark cairn in a round paved bay in the 0.075 m aerial photographs (2025-26), 9 m south of Overture's Sheepdog Memorial record

spawn.note: the postcard: 32 m south-south-west of the Church of the Good Shepherd on bare ground (LiDAR DSM minus DEM 0.0 m), 2.6 m below its floor, looking up the lake along the church's own axis. Behind the south gable and the belfry lie the lake, the head of the lake (bearing 13 degrees, 25.5 km) and Mistake Peak (3 degrees, 24.3 km); the Two Thumb Range rises on the right (Beuzenberg Peak 27 degrees). Mt John stands left of the frame at 324 degrees and hides Aoraki (329 degrees, 53 km: 3.0 degrees up against Mt John's 7.4 degrees). Bearings from WGS84 geodesics; see docs/cities/lake-tekapo.md, The first view
